spans.s: कृश् vi. 4P (pres. कृश्यति) 1. To become lean, to become emaciated; 2. to wane (as the moon).

कृष् (I) vt. 1P (pp. कृष्ट) 1. To draw, to drag, to pull, to tear, प्रसह्य सिंहः किल तां चकर्षR.ii.27; 2. to attract, Bg.xv.7; 3. to lead or conduct, as an army, e.g. स सेनां महतीं कर्षन् R.iv.32; 4. to bond (as a bow), नात्यायतकृष्टशार्ङ्गः R.v.50; 5. to become master of, to overpower, to subdue, बलवानिंद्रियग्रामो विद्वांसमपि कर्षति M.ii.215; 6. to plough, e.g. अनुलोमकृष्टं क्षेत्रं प्रतिलोमं कर्षति; 7. to obtain, e.g. कर्षति च महद्यशः.With अप-, 1. to draw back or away, to pull off, to take away, to drag away, दंतच्छदं प्रियतमेन निपीतसारं दंताग्रभिन्नमपकृष्य निरीक्षते च Rt.iv.14, R.xvi.55; 2. to lessen, to diminish.With अव-, to draw, to draw away from.With आ-, 1. to draw, to draw towards, to pull, to attract, दूरममुना सारंगेण वयमाकृष्टाः Sak.i., नाकस्माद् युवती वृद्धं केशेष्वाकृष्य चुंबति Hit.i., Am.

, K.S.ii.59, R.i.23; 2. to bend, as a bow, Sis.ix.40; 3. to snatch, to take by force, Bt.xvi.30; 4. to supply a word or words from a previous sentence.With उद्-, 1. to draw up, to pull up, to extricate, अंगदकोटिलग्नं प्रालंबमुत्कृष्य R.vi.14; 2. to enhance, to increase.With नि-, to sink down, to diminish.With निस्-, 1. to draw out, to pull out; 2. to exact, to snatch, to take by force, निष्क्रष्टुमर्थं चकमे कुबेरात् R.v.26.With परि-, to draw, to pull, to drag.With प्र-, 1. to draw away, to pull, to attract; 2. to lead, as an army; 3. to bend, as a bow.With वि-, 1. to draw, to pull; 2. to bend, as a bow, करासनं तेषु विकृष्यतामिदम् Sak.vi.With विप्र-, to remove.With संनि-, to make near.
कृष् (II) vt. 6Ā (pp. कृष्ट) To make furrows, to plough.
कृश a. (f. शा; compar. क्रशीयस्; super. क्रशिष्ठ) 1. Lean, emaciated, weak, M.iv.184; 2. small, little, minute (in size or quantity), e.g. सुहृदपि न याच्यः कृशधनः Bhartr.ii.28; 3. poor, M.vii.208.
कृश a. (f. शा; compar. क्रशीयस्; super. क्रशिष्ठ) 1. Lean, emaciated, weak, M.iv.184; 2. small, little, minute (in size or quantity), e.g. सुहृदपि न याच्यः कृशधनः Bhartr.ii.28; 3. poor, M.vii.208.
कृश-अक्ष m. a spider.
कृश-अंगी f. 1. a woman with a slender frame; 2. the priyangu creeper.
कृश-उदर a. thin-waisted.
कृशला f. Hair.
कृशानु m. Fire, गुरोः कृशानुप्रतिमाद्विभेषि R.ii.49, vii.24, x.74, K.S.i.51.
कृशानु-रेतस् m. an epithet of Śiva.
कृशाश्विन् m. An actor.
कृषक m. 1. A plough-man, a farmer; 2. a plough-share; 3. an ox.
कृषाण m. A ploughman, a husbandman.
कृषाण m. A ploughman, a husbandman.
कृषि f. 1. Ploughing; 2. agriculture, husbandry, चीयते वालिशस्यापि सत्क्षेत्रपतिता कृषिः Mud.i., Bg.xviii.44, M.i.90, iii.64.
कृषि-जीविन् a. living by husbandry.
कृषि-फल n. agricultural produce or profit, Megh.i.16.
कृषि-सेवा f. agriculture.
कृषीवल m. One who lives by husbandry, a farmer, कृषिं चापि कृषीवलः Yaj.i.276.
कृष्कर m. An epithet of Śiva.
कृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Drawn, attracted; 2. ploughed, (pp. of कृष् q.v.)
कृष्ट a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Drawn, attracted; 2. ploughed, (pp. of कृष् q.v.)
कृष्टि (I) m. A learned man.
कृष्टि (II) f. 1. Drawing, pulling, attracting; 2. ploughing.
कृष्ण (I) a. (f. ष्णा) 1. Black, dark, dark-blue; 2. wicked, evil.

कृष्ण (II) m. 1. The black colour; 2. the black antelope; 3. a crow; 4. the Indian cuckoo; 5. the dark half of a lunar month, from full to new moon; 6. the Kali age; 7. Viṣṇu in his eighth incarnation as the son of Vasudeva and Devaki, e.g. बहिरिव मलिनतरं तव कृष्ण मनोऽपि भविष्यति नूनम् Git.G.viii.; 8. an epithet of Vyāsa, the reputed author of the Mahābhārata; 9. an epithet of Arjuna; 10. aloewood.
कृष्ण (III) n. 1. Blackness, darkness (physical and moral); 2. iron; 3. antimony; 4. the black part of the eye; 5. black pepper.
कृष्ण (I) a. (f. ष्णा) 1. Black, dark, dark-blue; 2. wicked, evil.
कृष्णा f. 1. An epithet of द्रौपदी, wife of the Pāṇḍavas; 2. name of a river in the Dekkan.
कृष्ण-अगुरु n. a kind of sandalwood.
कृष्ण-अचल m. an epithet of the mountain Raivataka.
कृष्ण-अजिन n. the skin of the black antelope.
कृष्ण-अयस्, -अयस, -आमिष n. iron, crude or black iron.
कृष्ण-अयस्, -अयस, -आमिष n. iron, crude or black iron.
कृष्ण-अयस्, -अयस, -आमिष n. iron, crude or black iron.
कृष्ण-अध्वन्, -अर्चिस् m. fire.
कृष्ण-अध्वन्, -अर्चिस् m. fire.
कृष्ण-अष्टमी f. the eighth day of the dark half of Śrāvaṇa, which was the birthday of Kṛṣṇa.
कृष्ण-आवास m. the holy fig tree.
कृष्ण-उदर m. a species of snake.
कृष्ण-कंद n. a red lotus.
कृष्ण-कर्मन् a. of black deeds, criminal, guilty.
कृष्ण-काक m. a raven.
कृष्ण-काय m. a buffalo.
कृष्ण-काष्ठ n. a kind of sandalwood.
कृष्ण-कोहल m. a gambler.
कृष्ण-गति m. fire, आयोधने कृष्णगतिं सहायमवाप्य R.vi.42.
कृष्ण-ग्रीव m. an epithet of Śiva.
कृष्ण-तार m. 1. a species of antelope; 2. an antelope in general.
कृष्ण-देह m. a bee.
कृष्ण-धन n. money acquired by foul means.
कृष्ण-द्वैपायन m. a name of Vyāsa, तमहमरागमकृष्णं कृष्णद्वैपायनं वंदे Ve.i.
कृष्ण-पक्ष m. the dark half of a lunar month.
कृष्ण-मृग m. the black antelope, शृंगे कृष्णमृगस्य वामनयनं कंडूयमानां मृगीम् Sak.vi.
कृष्ण-मुख, -वक्त्र, -वदन m. the black-faced monkey.
कृष्ण-मुख, -वक्त्र, -वदन m. the black-faced monkey.
कृष्ण-मुख, -वक्त्र, -वदन m. the black-faced monkey.
कृष्ण-यजुर्वेद m. the Taittirīya or black Yajurveda.
कृष्ण-लोह m. the loadstone.
कृष्ण-वर्ण m. 1. a name of Rāhu; 2. a śūdra.
कृष्ण-वर्त्मन् m. 1. fire, R.xi.42, M.ii.94; 2. an epithet of Rāhu; 3. a low man, a profligate.
कृष्ण-वेणा f. name of a river.
कृष्ण-शकुनि m. a crow.
कृष्ण-शार, -सार m. the spotted antelope, कृष्णसारे ददचक्षुः त्वयि चाधिज्यकार्मुके Sak.i.
कृष्ण-शार, -सार m. the spotted antelope, कृष्णसारे ददचक्षुः त्वयि चाधिज्यकार्मुके Sak.i.
कृष्ण-शृंग m. a buffalo.
कृष्ण-सख, -सारथि m. an epithet of Arjuna.
कृष्ण-सख, -सारथि m. an epithet of Arjuna.
कृष्णक n. The hide of the black antelope.
कृष्णल (I) m. The gunjā plant.
कृष्णल (II) n. Its berry.
कृष्णिका f. Black mustard.
कृष्णिमन् m. Blackness.
कृष्णी f. A dark night.
